parsed.reason: The reply says plainly that Hale cannot do the sign-up and does not claim it did or will. It offers the allowed alternative of watching one class page the parent sends. That watch is set up by the parent's request, so it is not a promise to text later once sign-up becomes possible. Small weakness: the offer only applies if the class is full and does not mention texting when a spot opens, but the meaning is clear enough.
